## 中文原文

早上你本来打算早点出门去图书馆学习。收拾好背包，吃完简单的早餐之后，你打开电脑想查一点学习资料。结果刷社交软件不知不觉耗掉了不少时间。等你反应过来，已经快中午了。你有点懊恼，只好改变计划，决定下午再去图书馆。

## My translation

In this morning, I was planning to leave home earlier, in order to study at the library.

I packed up my belongings first, then had a simple breakfast.

I opened my computer to look for some learning resources, but I ended up wasting a lot of time on social media.

By the time I realized, it was nearly noon. I was a bit frustrated, but I had to change my plan—going to the library in the afternoon.

## Revised version

This morning, I'd planned to leave home early to study at the library.

I packed my things and had a quick simple breakfast.

I opened my laptop to look up some study resources, but I ended up wasting lots of time scrolling through social media.

When I realized what had happened, it was almost noon.

I felt a little frustrated, so I had to adjust my plans and go to the library in the afternoon instead.

## Key phrases

- **look up**：表示查阅资料，比 *look for* 更好
- **scroll through social media**：刷社交媒体
- **adjust plans**：调整计划，比 *change plans* 更符合语境
- **instead**：放在最后，表示替代
